identity.wikipedia: United States of the Ionian Islands

land.text: the islands Britain took from France: Zakynthos and Kefalonia 1809, Lefkada 1810

predecessors.note: Corfu's fate before 1815 is not on the page; the infobox protectorate dates from 9 November 1815.

successors.note: The page's text gives a proclamation on 28 May and union on 2 June 1864; the infobox says 21 May.

correction.text: 'It included seven island states' (Corfu, Cephalonia, Cythera, Ithaca, Paxos, Lefkada, Zakynthos)

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria has no Ionian row; it draws six or seven cells of the islands as direct UK land in 1820-1869. The page gives 4,696 km2 for 1864 (infobox) against 2,021 km2 for the gazetteer's Ionian Islands region (ratio 0.43, beyond a factor of two: the grid undercounts small islands, so the shape is the islands' outline, not an area to trust). 'It included seven island states': Corfu, Cephalonia, Cythera, Ithaca, Paxos, Lefkada and Zakynthos.

ledger.note: November 1815: the Ionian Islands become a British protectorate. The Treaty of Paris of 5 November 1815: 'Britain obtained a protectorate over the Ionian Islands'; infobox 'Protectorate established: 9 November 1815'; a 'Lord High Commissioner, appointed by the British government' ('1816-1824: Sir Thomas Maitland (first)').

9 November 1815: the islands become a British protectorate. Infobox 'Status: Protectorate of the British Empire', 'Protectorate established: 9 November 1815'. Mirror of the united-kingdom vassal_start (added by reviewer eu-11-l).
21 May 1864: union with Greece ends the protectorate. Infobox 'Union with Greece: 21 May 1864'. Mirror of the united-kingdom vassal_end (added by reviewer eu-11-l).

May 1864: the islands join Greece. The Treaty of London of 29 March 1864 was 'pledging the transfer of sovereignty to Greece upon ratification'; infobox 'Union with Greece: 21 May 1864' (the text gives 28 May and 2 June).

certainty.note: Islands: the coasts are the borders.

sources.note: United States of the Ionian Islands: protectorate 9 November 1815, seven islands, Lord High Commissioners, Treaty of London 29 March 1864, union with Greece 21 May 1864; infobox area 4,696 km2 (1864).

notes: Written from one page, a protectorate Cliopatria lacks that the united-kingdom dossier needs as a counterpart (vassal_start November 1815, vassal_end May 1864). Typed colony so it is drawn as a tint of the British metropole. The captures of Zakynthos and Kefalonia (1809) and Lefkada (1810) are on the page but belong to a French or Venetian-era state that no row covers; Corfu's 1814 status is not on the page. The gazetteer's 'Ionian Islands' region has 7 cells (2,021 km2) against 4,696 km2 in the infobox. Only two Lord High Commissioners are on the page, so no rulers list. REVIEW eu-11-l (2026-10-25): vassal_start/vassal_end with united-kingdom added to mirror that dossier's events.
